title: A Bilinear Kakeya Inequality in the Heisenberg Group
summary: We prove a bilinear Kakeya inequality in the first Heisenberg group and a sharp bilinear Kakeya estimate for Euclidean curved tubes in $\R^2$. By adapting an argument of Fässler, Pinamonti and Wald involving Heisenberg projections, we show that the latter implies the former. We prove the estimate for curved tubes using a combination of techniques developed by Pramanik, Yang and Zahl, Wolff and Schlag.
